name: Art-Directable Multiple Volumetric Scattering
definition: A method that computes efficient and physically accurate diffusion (multi-bounce scattering) while allowing independent control over contrast, addressing the need for art-directability in high-albedo media rendering.
summary: Art-Directable Multiple Volumetric Scattering is a path tracing method that computes efficient multi-bounce diffusion in participating media while decoupling physical diffusion from visual contrast for independent artistic control.
